title: Personal Training Packages: session-credit rollover allowance and upfront deposit by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, whether unused sessions may roll into a renewed package, the maximum number of sessions that may roll over, and the upfront deposit required at purchase.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Session rollover allowed | Maximum sessions that may roll over | Upfront deposit required (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | Yes | 5 | 0.00 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | Yes | 5 | 200.00 |

## Points of reference
Only 20-Session Performance Pack and Elite Specialty Coaching allow unused sessions to roll into a renewed package, each capping the rollover at 5 sessions; every other tier of Personal Training Packages does not allow rollover. Elite Specialty Coaching is the sole tier requiring an upfront deposit at purchase, at 200.00 dollars; every other tier requires no deposit.
